content: When the rhythm of the drum changes, so must the steps of the dance.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: To continue stomping the old steps when the master drummer has transitioned into a new tempo makes a dancer look ridiculous and clumsy. When the season of your career, age, or relationship shifts, stop fighting reality—attune your ears and learn the new dance.
practicalInsight: Acknowledge where the music has changed in your life. Release the old choreography and embrace the new rhythm.
reflectionPrompt: What outdated 'dance' are you continuing to perform even though life has completely changed the music?
